args.title: checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy — rolled back to v2.3.0

trace.final:
Both actions are complete and verified:

**Rollback**
- Deployed v2.3.1 was failing health checks in all production regions with an 18% error rate.
- Rolled back all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) to **v2.3.0**, the most recent release that was healthy in production.
- Confirmed post-rollback status: service is now **healthy** with error rate down to 0.2%.

**Incident**
- Opened **INC-0001** (SEV2) for checkout-api: "checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy — rolled back to v2.3.0", with a summary of the failure and the rollback action taken. On-call has been paged.

Note: v2.3.1 should be treated as blocked from re-release until the root cause of the health check failures is identified — I'd suggest the on-call engineer investigate before any redeploy.
